entities.name: Gabriel de Magalhães
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gabriel de Magalhães, or gallicized as Gabriel Magaillans, was an early Portuguese Jesuit missionary to China who was one of the first Catholic missionaries to reach Sichuan. He also worked in Peking and founded the original St. Joseph's Church there.
